traditional: 話 A 係 B 寫嘅
jyutping: waa6 A hai6 B se2 ge3

english.note: Use this natural spoken construction when saying that a work was written by a particular person.

examples.english: We attribute this article to Ming as its author.
examples.traditional: 我哋話呢篇文章係阿明寫嘅。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 waa6 ni1 pin1 man4 zoeng1 hai6 aa3 ming4 se2 ge3
